name: Feature request
about: Describe a user problem and a focused proposal
title: ""
---

Search existing issues and read [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/FireTheDevil/pi-openui/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md) before proposing substantive work. Remove secrets, usernames, home paths, private transcripts, and identifying screenshot content.

## User problem

What task are you trying to complete? What happens now, and what outcome do you want?

## Proposed change

Describe the smallest useful change. Include a concrete example or minimal OpenUI source if it helps.

## Alternatives

Why do existing components, plain text, or another available tool not meet the need?

## Scope and compatibility

Identify affected modes, components, APIs, dependencies, and possible migration needs. Ask for approval before adding dependencies or introducing breaking API changes.

## Environment and evidence

If relevant, include OpenUI, Pi, and Node.js versions, operating system, terminal, host TUI mode, interaction mode, presentation, and execution path. Include adapter version and backend if used. Add sanitized screenshots and describe checks or limitations.
